title: Asymptotic stability of Bernstein-Greene-Kruskal (BGK) waves, Landau Damping, and scattering theory
summary: We consider the two species (electrons and positive charged ions) Vlasov-Poisson system linearized around BGK waves. We formulate the problem as an equivalent Vlasov-Ampère system, that we write as a system of Schrödinger type in an appropriate Hilbert space, and with a selfadjoint Vlasov-Ampère operator as a Hamiltonian. We develop a complete stationary scattering theory.
